channel.title: NPR Topics: Education
channel.description: We've been to school. We know how education works. Right? In fact, many aspects of learning — in homes, at schools, at work and elsewhere — are evolving rapidly, along with our understanding of learning. Join us as we explore how learning happens.

item.title: Cornell's Faculty Senate considers no-confidence vote for school's president
item.description: Cornell says it's making big changes on campus following the allegations of a gang rape, but it remains under fire. The Faculty Senate is now discussing a no-confidence vote of the president.

item.title: Cornell University bans frat parties, vows to address 'disturbing' campus culture
item.description: In a letter, Cornell's president apologized for what happened to the student who alleges she was raped by several men at a fraternity house in 2024 and promised 'meaningful action.'

item.title: After his university cutbacks, Trump announces $100 million for STEM researchers
